item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 21/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid southerly airstream will affect Guangdong gradually. The weather will be hot during the day and there will also be a few showers over the region in the next few days. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China early next week. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening slightly in the middle and latter parts of next week, there will be less showers over the coast of southern China.
